data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 学校天台的青梅便当
data.description: 正午阳光洒满学校天台，微风吹拂着栗色双马尾。伊莉娜双手捧着画有爱心番茄酱的蛋包饭送到你唇边，两手托腮露出如向日葵般灿烂元气的笑容，满心欢喜。
data.location: school rooftop under bright blue sunny sky
data.action: offering omelet rice with spoon, chin resting on hands, beaming radiant smile, twintails fluttering in breeze
data.lighting: brilliant cheerful noon sunlight casting sharp clear shadows
data.mood: sunshine childhood romance, boundless energy, warm nostalgia
data.promptProse: Standing on the school rooftop in uniform, Irina Shidou beams happily as she feeds partner omelet rice with a spoon in the sunshine.
data.animaCaption: Irina Shidou feeding omelet rice on the school rooftop with a sunny beaming smile.
